name: 01880 · Wakefield, MA
findings: ZIP 01880 (Wakefield) has 148 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 59 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01880 (Wakefield) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
